runtime_contract: Original renderer consumes CP932 pairs, not plain ASCII. Original fullwidth-space placement is layout evidence only. Do not overwrite with ASCII or truncate complete prose to fit the old allocation.

records.source_japanese: 情報モード。画面上の街や船の情報を見ることができます。対象を選んでください。
records.heading: Info Mode
records.english: View information about the cities and ships on screen. Select a target.
records.context: Pressing Y from normal Sea View opens the information mode panel; the ship/city target is selected on the lower screen.
records.source_meaning: Inspect information about on-screen cities and ships, then select the object to inspect.
records.localization_note: Preserve every instruction in natural English. Automatic wrapping uses forty six-pixel cells per native sprite row.

records.source_japanese: 探索モード。Ａボタンで探索を実行します。探索の結果、水・食糧・アイテムなどが見つかることがあります。見つからなかったときは、水夫の疲労度が３上がります。探索途中で水夫が脱走したり、獣に襲われたりすることもあります。
records.heading: Search Mode
records.english: Press A to search. You may find water, food, items, or other supplies. If you find nothing, sailor fatigue rises by 3. Sailors may desert or be attacked by wild animals while searching.
records.context: A second Y press from normal sailing selects Search Mode; the lower screen highlights the player's ship and offers A Search.
records.source_meaning: A executes a search. Water, food or items may be found. Failure adds exactly 3 sailor fatigue; desertion or animal attacks can occur during searching.
records.localization_note: Do not imply that desertion/animal attacks happen only after an unsuccessful search, or drop the exact fatigue increase.

records.source_japanese: 宣戦モード。画面上の艦隊・街に戦闘をしかけます。攻撃対象を選ぶと、戦闘開始です。宣戦すると、自動的に相手勢力との関係が交戦中になり、友好度が大きく下がります。同盟中の勢力の艦隊には宣戦できません。
records.heading: Declare War Mode
records.english: Select a fleet or city on screen to begin a battle. Declaring war puts you at war with that faction and greatly lowers goodwill. You cannot declare war on an allied faction's fleets.
records.context: A third Y press selects Declare War Mode. Targets are fleets/cities on the lower screen; the tested empty target area displays the original no-target message separately.
records.source_meaning: Selecting a fleet/city starts combat and changes faction relations to at war with a large goodwill penalty. Allied fleets cannot be targeted.
records.localization_note: Preserve the source's fleet-specific alliance restriction; do not broaden it into an unsupported rule about every allied city.
